verdict.rationale: LM Studio explicitly ships 'llmster', a documented headless daemon designed for servers, CI environments, and cloud instances with no GUI required, plus a CLI (lms) for scripting model loads, server start/stop, and chat, backed by a REST API for automation. Community evidence (lm-studio-comm-17) corroborates a usable headless flow, though some users note the main app still needs the Electron GUI in certain modes (lm-studio-comm-13), suggesting llmster is a newer/less universally validated path. Missing for 10: independent CI pipeline case studies or deeper hands-on verification of llmster's stability/limitations in production automation.
